Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: editorial cover for Moth & Gravel Field Note draft 'A receipt should say what arrived'.
Primary request: a quiet, strange editorial still life: a small blank bone-coloured paper receipt held securely beneath a single rough dark stone; an unsealed paper envelope beside it has a narrow brass-coloured thread extending into darkness. The receipt is present and tangible; the far end of the thread is unseen.
Style/medium: tactile analogue collage with restrained photographic paper and stone textures, subtle grain, deliberate imperfect cut edges. Studio palette bone paper, charcoal, muted brass.
Composition/framing: wide landscape, generous negative space, objects concentrated near centre, editorial rather than product advertisement.
Lighting/mood: low angled soft light, curious and calm.
Constraints: no readable writing, typography, numbers, green check marks, logos, people, software screenshots, interface elements or watermark. This is a visual metaphor, not a diagram.
